items.notes: Same page: 'báo cáo từ hơn 50.000 doanh nghiệp (với hơn 4,2 triệu lao động)'; 'doanh nghiệp FDI khoảng 9,21 triệu đồng/người (tăng 12%)'; 'doanh nghiệp dân doanh khoảng 7,37 triệu đồng/người (tăng 9%)'; 'Doanh nghiệp nhà nước khoảng 9,44 triệu đồng/người (tăng 23%)'. Corroborated by baophapluat.vn 24/02/2026 citing Bộ Nội vụ: 'mức thưởng bình quân là 8,69 triệu đồng/người, tăng 13% so với mức thưởng dịp Tết Nguyên đán năm 2025' '(7,72 triệu đồng/người)'. The Tết bonus is NOT statutory; the Labour Code has no 13th-month obligation (no official source states a 13th-month norm — see notFound). The LFS income figures already include bonuses received in the survey month.

items.what: Average asking rent, ready-built factories (RBF), Northern Vietnam, Q2 2026
items.scope: Average asking rent, RBF, Northern Vietnam (Hanoi, Bac Ninh, Hai Phong, Hung Yen…); inclusive of service charge, exclusive of VAT
items.quote: The average asking rent for ready-built factories in Northern Vietnam remained stable at 5.0 USD/sqm/month in Q2 2026, recording moderate growth of 0.4% QoQ and 2.3% YoY.
items.notes: Cushman & Wakefield Northern Vietnam Industrial MarketBeat Q2 2026 (published Aug 2026). Footer: 'All rents of RBF/RBW are inclusive of SC but exclusive of VAT. … USD/VND = 26,350 in Q2 2026'. Industrial land (IP) same report: 'The average asking rent for industrial land in Q2 2026 reached 137.7 USD/sqm/lease term' (excl. management fees and VAT). Second broker: JLL via VnEconomy (17 Oct 2026, RBF section): 'JLL recorded average asking rents of $5 per sq m per month in the south and $5.3 in the north in the second quarter.' items.quote: The average rent for the whole market reached 4.9 USD/sqm/month (+0.1% QoQ, +2.5% YoY). However, price trends among provinces showed clear differences. HCMC led at 5.1 USD/sqm/month (+0.4% QoQ, +4.1% YoY). Dong Nai recorded 4.9 USD/sqm/month (+0.3% QoQ, +1.6% YoY). Tay Ninh, the new satellite market, recorded 4.6 USD/sqm/month (-0.4% QoQ, +1.8% YoY).
